key.name: menu-title
key.description: The title label shown on the top panel button.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Panel section: left, center, or right.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Position index within the panel section.

key.name: stick-to-zorin-menu
key.description: Keep Options fixed immediately next to the primary start/Zorin menu icon.

key.name: menu-items
key.description: JSON array defining the custom menu items, their icons, types, and target actions.

key.name: enable-adb
key.description: Automatically detect connected Android ADB devices and create dedicated panel menus.

key.name: scrcpy-max-size
key.description: Maximum dimension in pixels for app windows (1024, 1280, 1920, or 0 for native).

key.name: scrcpy-bitrate
key.description: Bitrate allocated to each scrcpy stream (e.g. 2M, 4M, 8M).

key.name: scrcpy-stay-awake
key.description: Prevent Android from putting virtual displays to sleep during mirroring.

key.name: scrcpy-no-audio
key.description: Prevents audio stream deadlock when running multiple app windows concurrently.

key.name: scrcpy-extra-args
key.description: Optional additional arguments passed to scrcpy.
